title: A layout report
description:
Print where each member of a struct sits, and the padding.

```
struct Player (32 bytes, align 8)
  offset 0   name     char[12]
  offset 12  level    int
  offset 16  position double
  offset 24  alive    bool
  7 bytes of padding at the end
```
hints: Padding after a member is the next offset minus the end of this member (lesson 2.05).
Look at the same struct in the Memory window with `0xCC` filled padding in a debug build.
requirements: Work out each gap from the offsets and sizes.
Reorder the members to save space and print the new size.
stretch: Add `#pragma pack(1)` and see what it changes and what it costs.
